## Success & Failure Criteria

> Defined BEFORE we run the test. Not "we'll know it when we see it."

| Outcome | Criteria | Decision |
|---------|---------|---------|
| Validated | [e.g., ≥ 4/5 users complete task without prompting] | Proceed to build |
| Partially validated | [e.g., 3/5 users succeed but with friction] | Iterate design, retest |
| Invalidated | [e.g., < 3/5 users succeed OR users misunderstand the concept] | [See below] |

---
